styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and real-shot screens, light sky-blue #BFE3F7 for benefit, scene and infographic screens; occasional warm sand-beige #E7D7BE for outdoor scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-toned studio lighting, gentle top or upper-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte neutral board #EFE9E1 and light sand-toned stone #E7D7BE
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline in deep navy #1E4A6D, short Chinese phrases only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line check icons and numbered circles, single warm orange accent #F59E1B
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product presentation, consistent scale across the set, hero angle repeats across benefit and CTA shots
noDrift: no invented SPF or PA numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh water-light sun-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, light sky-blue #BFE3F7, deep navy text #1E4A6D and one warm orange accent #F59E1B; bright soft daylight-toned studio lighting with gentle highlights and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline typography in deep navy; consistent rounded rectangular info chips and thin-line check icons; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product presentation with consistent scale and clean balanced composition; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
